entries.mechanism: TAXSIM runs at its latest 2024 law year. Kentucky's section 141.020 flat rate stepped down from 4.0 per cent (2024) to 3.5 per cent (2026) and the section 141.081 standard deduction was indexed (3,160 in 2024 to 3,344 in 2026), so the 2026 tax is lower than TAXSIM's 2024 computation. The 2024 schedule 0.04*(AGI-3,160) reproduces TAXSIM to the cent. The pipeline reports 932.96; TAXSIM 2024 reports 1073.60. Pinned-2024-law-year vintage, not a pipeline defect; the pipeline matches PolicyEngine at 2026 to the cent.
